sloka: न मया सत्कृता देवि सत्कारार्हा कृते तव ।इदानीम् तत्तपति माम् यन्मया सुकृतम् त्वयि ॥२-१२-७०॥
transliteration: na mayā satkṛtā devi satkārārhā kṛte tava ।idānīm tattapati mām yanmayā sukṛtam tvayi ॥2-12-70॥

translations.english: I have done many favours to you. Like a sick person afflicted by eating rice mixed with unwholesome curry, those acts of kindness are burning me now.
